post.description: Expands a repeat rule without saving anything. Occurrences are generated by advancing local wall-clock time in the rule's IANA time zone and converting each one to UTC individually, so a weekly 7pm event stays at 7pm across a daylight-saving change. Check `warnings` for occurrences that fell in a DST gap, landed on an ambiguous hour, or were clamped to a shorter month.
